MyExodus uses this to tell which app is in front. Without it, app blocking can’t run.
To block apps and sites, MyExodus checks the name of the app you switch to — and, in supported browsers only, the address-bar text. App names and usage times stay on this device.

Detects when you open an app or website on your list and shows the block screen right away. Without it, blocks still work — they just start up to a few seconds later while detection falls back to polling.
Used only for a warning before a daily limit runs out and for protection alerts. Blocking works without it — you just won’t get a heads-up.
Lets MyExodus show the block screen on top of a blocked app, including the fallback used when Accessibility is off. Without it, that fallback can’t block or warn.
